summary: 35 items need a reply: 28 P1, 1 P2 and 6 P3; 28 are late. The biggest block is comments under Meta ads (13), which never show in the Page feed. Buyers' top doubt is "will it work for me" (3 commenters, 2 ads, 2,802.80 USD of spend behind it). The highest-spend ad, "Reminders cut no-shows (video)", is flagged for a creative review: price complaints (people doubt the monthly cost is worth it for reminders). On Google Play, "login loop after update" leads the bug report and is new in 3.8.1. 8 hide-list entries cover scams and spam, including an account posing as support.
